paper_title: Advancing Globular Cluster Constraints on the Axion-Photon Coupling
notes: Constraint from globular cluster stellar evolution using the R₂-parameter (HB to AGB stellar population ratio) from Hubble Space Telescope observations. Most conservative limit of g_aγγ < 0.47 × 10⁻¹⁰ GeV⁻¹ obtained using semiconvection convective boundary mixing scheme. Derived by comparing stellar evolution simulations with MESA (including axion energy-loss via Primakoff process) to observed globular cluster parameters. Stellar cooling bounds are mass-independent and apply across the plotted mass range 10⁻⁸ to 10 eV. Complementary evidence from asteroseismology supports a tighter bound of g_aγγ < 0.34 × 10⁻¹⁰ GeV⁻¹ but the conservative value is reported as the main result. The constraint improves upon the previous R-parameter bound from Dolan et al. (2021) by considering the R₂-parameter which is more robust and less dependent on convective boundary modeling assumptions.
